# Traffic Drop at S-SFX-005 due to Planned Fiber Maintenance

- **Classification:** planned_maintenance
- **Root cause:** planned_maintenance at `LNK-SFX-01-A`
- **Confidence:** high (Directly evidenced by matching maintenance window MW-0005, link loss alarm ALM-000212, and site down alarms with precise timing alignment. External events were NOT CHECKED via tool call.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-12 03:15 to 2026-09-12 06:15
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-12 03:21
- **Affected:** S-SFX-005, S-SFX-004, S-SFX-006

## Summary

Planned fiber splice work on link LNK-SFX-01-A caused downstream sites including S-SFX-005 to go offline.

Traffic, active users, and availability dropped to zero at S-SFX-005 and sibling sites S-SFX-004 and S-SFX-006 for approximately 3 hours during planned fiber splice work.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-12 03:21: Planned maintenance window MW-0005 started on LNK-SFX-01-A for fiber splice work. [MW-0005]
- 2026-09-12 03:28: Critical LINK_LOS alarm raised on LNK-SFX-01-A. [ALM-000212]
- 2026-09-12 03:29: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-SFX-005, S-SFX-004, and S-SFX-006. [ALM-000213, ALM-000214, ALM-000215]
- 2026-09-12 06:13: LINK_LOS on LNK-SFX-01-A and SITE_DOWN on S-SFX-005 and S-SFX-004 cleared. [ALM-000212, ALM-000213, ALM-000214]
- 2026-09-12 06:14: SITE_DOWN on S-SFX-006 cleared. [ALM-000215]
- 2026-09-12 06:19: Planned maintenance window MW-0005 completed. [MW-0005]

## Evidence

- Traffic, active users, and availability dropped to zero at S-SFX-005 between 2026-09-12 03:15 and 06:15. [ALR-0012, ANM-000174, ANM-000169, ANM-000175]
- S-SFX-005 depends on LNK-SFX-01-A, AGG-SFX-01, and CORE-UPF-02. [T2]
- A fiber splice maintenance window MW-0005 was active on LNK-SFX-01-A during the incident time. [MW-0005]
- No configuration changes occurred on the affected nodes and parents during the window. [T4]

## Hypotheses

1. **planned_maintenance** at LNK-SFX-01-A: confirmed. Maintenance window MW-0005 explicitly noted expected downstream sites offline during fiber splicing, perfectly matching the timing of the link loss and site down alarms. [MW-0005, ALM-000212, ALM-000213]
2. **bad_change** at S-SFX-005: rejected. No changes were recorded on S-SFX-005, LNK-SFX-01-A, AGG-SFX-01, or parent nodes during the time window. [T4]

## Ruled out

- T4: No configuration changes were found on the node or its ancestors during the incident window.

## Recommended actions

- Verify that customer communications for maintenance window MW-0005 were sent to account for expected downtime.
